answer: Temporal Echo Ledger.** Each identity must emit a signed heartbeat every epoch, and newcomers' first N heartbeats are stored under a provisional key traceable to their registration. Any cluster of identities sharing timing signatures, IP-atlas coordinates, or referral paths gets flagged, and all its provisional keys are voided together — a clone can't echo its creator without collapsing the whole cluster. Cost: each sybil needs fresh infrastructure, distinct timing behavior, and an independent oasis of activity, making the marginal clone negative-EV.
